title: Solar Installation Technician
description: Install and maintain residential and small commercial solar systems with a focus on safety and quality.
responsibilities: Install panels, mounting frames, and basic wiring.
Perform system checks and record readings.
Explain basic system care to customers.
requirements: Practical solar installation training, attention to safety, and willingness to learn.

title: Junior ICT Support Assistant
description: Provide first-line IT support for hardware, software, and basic network issues.
responsibilities: Set up workstations, printers, and networks.
requirements: Foundational ICT skills and clear written and verbal communication.

title: Electrical Installation Trainee
description: Assist experienced electricians with supervised installation and maintenance work.
responsibilities: Assist with wiring and fittings under supervision.
Follow site safety rules and keep work areas tidy.
requirements: Electrical installation training and commitment to safety.

title: Welder/Fabricator
description: Carry out welding, cutting, and fabrication work for gates, doors, and metal structures.
responsibilities: Read and interpret basic fabrication drawings.
Cut, bend, and weld metal components.
Inspect finished work for quality and safety.
requirements: Welding and fabrication training with practical experience.

title: Plumber
description: Install and repair plumbing systems for residential and commercial clients.
responsibilities: Diagnose and repair leaks and blockages.
requirements: Plumbing training and knowledge of basic fittings.

title: Caterer
description: Prepare and serve meals for events, offices, and catering contracts.
requirements: Catering and hospitality training with attention to hygiene.

title: Fashion Designer/Seamstress
description: Sew, alter, and design garments for retail and custom orders.
requirements: Tailoring and fashion design training.

title: Auto Mechanic
description: Diagnose and repair vehicles including engines, brakes, and electrical systems.
responsibilities: Repair and replace parts as needed.
Keep service records and work area clean.
requirements: Auto mechanics training with basic diagnostic skills.

title: Data Entry Specialist
description: Enter, update, and maintain records in databases with accuracy.
requirements: Computer literacy and attention to detail.

title: Office Administrator
description: Handle administrative tasks, scheduling, and customer communications.
requirements: Good communication skills and basic computer proficiency.

title: Solar Installation Assistant

title: ICT Assistant

title: Electrician

title: Fabricator Assistant

title: Plumbing Assistant

title: Tailoring Assistant

title: Auto Mechanic Assistant
